summary: Nova Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K attaching its earnings press release for record third-quarter 2026 results (period ended September 30, 2026). Revenue reached $287.8 million, up 13% quarter-over-quarter and 28% year-over-year; GAAP net income was $90.0 million ($2.64 per diluted share) and non-GAAP $98.4 million ($2.86 per diluted share). Management guided fourth-quarter revenue to $305-315 million and non-GAAP EPS of $3.03-3.18. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are present; this is a routine earnings current report, not a special situation.
